summary: I presented the outline Level 1-3 baseline schedule at the kick-off meeting and proposed the submission and approval route with Meridian under A040, targeting approval by 10 January. I issued the Stakeholder Register (Rev A) covering QSE, Meridian, UzGridCo, the Regional Administration, subcontractors and vendors. I also wrote to Meridian to formalise the schedule review workflow.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
paragraphs: This register identifies the external and contractual stakeholders of the HELIOS 100 MW Solar PV + BESS Power Plant (HEL001) at Qizilqum Solar Site, Navoi Region, and records for each the named contact, interest in the project, relative influence and agreed communication channel. It is issued on 3 December 2026 following the Kick-off Meeting (M02) and uses the Client Representative and Owner's Engineer contacts confirmed at that meeting.

The register is owned by Planning (Aziz Karimov) and maintained with the Project Director. It will be reviewed monthly and whenever a contact changes, and feeds the Communications Plan and the baseline schedule coordination activities (A040).

sections.heading: 2. Stakeholder Register
paragraphs: Influence and interest are rated High, Medium or Low. All formal correspondence is numbered through the Document Controller (Nilufar Yusupova) under the project numbering procedure.

sections.heading: 3. Stakeholder Engagement Priorities
bullets: QSE and Meridian: agree the baseline schedule submission and approval route in A040, with Meridian approval targeted for 2027-01-10.
UzGridCo: early alignment of grid connection agreement and protection coordination, which drive the M10 (2028-01-20) and M11 (2028-02-15) milestones.

Navoi Regional Administration / State Construction Inspectorate: construction permit (M07, 2027-03-20) and land allocation and cadastral passport (A110, to 2027-02-15) are critical to M08 first piles on 2027-04-12.
Vendors: confirm delivery windows early so the procurement-linked schedule logic is credible, in particular modules for M09 (2027-07-20).

sections.heading: 4. Communication Rules
bullets: Formal instructions, notices, claims and submissions are by numbered letter only; email is for routine coordination and is not a contractual notice.
Schedule submissions to Meridian go by transmittal with native P6 (XER) file, PDF and narrative.
Weekly progress report each Friday and monthly report by the 5th working day; look-ahead issued weekly.
Site works run Monday to Saturday; site-facing communication with subcontractors is through the Construction Manager.

sections.heading: 5. Maintenance and Open Points
paragraphs: Contact telephone numbers and email addresses are held in the controlled contact list with Document Control and are not reproduced here. Open point: confirmation of the UzGridCo and State Construction Inspectorate secondary contacts and their preferred language for formal letters (Uzbek, Russian or English).
This register will be re-issued as Rev B after the first month of execution or upon any change in stakeholders.

letters.subject: Baseline Schedule L1-L3 - Proposed Submission and Review Route (HEL001)
body_paragraphs: Further to the Kick-off Meeting held today, Helios EPC LLC confirms the proposed route for submission and approval of the Baseline Programme (activity A040).

HEP will submit the Level 1-3 baseline in Primavera P6 (XER), PDF and a narrative covering logic, calendars (Monday to Saturday working), critical path and key assumptions. The outline baseline presented today is based on the contract milestones M00 to M14 and PAC on 2028-05-31.

We propose a one-week review window followed by a joint review workshop with Meridian and QSE, one comment round and resubmission, targeting approval by 2027-01-10. We ask Meridian to confirm the review contact, the number of review days and the format of comments.
Aziz Karimov will coordinate the submission and is available to walk Meridian through the model ahead of the formal transmittal.
